status: LOCKED before any calibration value or held-out depth-scan row exists
question: Does a task-independent calibration probe, with a rule fixed on the four development receivers, predict at which single-write depths the nine held-out receivers can use complete facts, before their depth profiles are measured?
layer_rule: round(depth x n_blocks); dev receivers use their R1 depth-scan layers

calibration.definition: synthetic two-object prompt (XOPA/YUME, all slots neutral) from the frozen renderer and receiver scaffold, question "What word is listed for XOPA?"; for each of the 221 symbols write h0 + d_s (gamma 1, raw fitted direction) at XOPA slot 0 final token at the single depth layer; score = max over {no-space, leading-space} first token of the logit gain at the answer position vs the neutral prompt; AUC_s = share of other symbols (disjoint first tokens) with lower gain (ties 0.5); metric = mean AUC_s
calibration.independence: no scene, bank, task question, answer or outcome is used

outcome.definition: four-answer success, fitted gamma 1 single write, complete facts, 92 development scenes (exposed_development minus 4 engineering scenes), 64-token budget, family-macro over 12 families; frozen evaluator src/syncomm/recovery/evaluate_depth.py via scripts/latest0924/run_patched.py

rule.primary: usable iff auc_mean(receiver, depth) >= tau; tau chosen on the 20 development cells to maximize balanced accuracy over candidate thresholds at midpoints between consecutive sorted development metric values; ties resolved by the midpoint between the smallest and largest tied candidate
rule.comparator: depth-only rule fitted the same way on the development cells (usable iff depth <= d_star)

predictions_file: artifacts/latest0924/predict/predictions.json, committed to git BEFORE the first held-out depth-scan outcome row (engineering rows allowed before)

scoring.primary: balanced accuracy of the primary rule over the 45 held-out receiver x depth cells
scoring.success_criterion: balanced accuracy >= 0.80 AND 95% cluster-bootstrap lower limit > 0.50 (resampling the 9 held-out receivers, 20,000 draws x seeds 20260924-6, enclosing interval)
secondary: Spearman(auc_mean, J) over held-out cells with the same bootstrap
balanced accuracy of the depth-only comparator and the difference primary - comparator (bootstrap)
per-receiver deepest usable depth, predicted vs observed
scoring.non_blind_check: predicted usable at depth 0.5 vs Experiment A middle-band success (J >= 50%, already observed) -- labelled NOT blind

reporting: all results reported whichever way they come out; misses reported as misses

amendments.before: any held-out calibration value or held-out outcome row
